name: Biology
new_description: Biology is the study of life - from the smallest building blocks of living organisms to the intricate ecosystems they inhabit. Delve into the inner workings of cells, uncovering how they use genetic information to sustain and reproduce themselves. Explore the diverse array of species, discovering how they have evolved unique adaptations to thrive in their environments. Investigate the complex webs of interactions that tie living things together, shaping the natural world around us.
focus_areas: cellular processes, genetics and heredity, evolution and adaptation, ecology and ecosystems

name: Chemistry
new_description: Dive into the fascinating world of Chemistry, where you'll unravel the mysteries of matter and energy. Explore the building blocks of our universe, from the tiniest atoms to the most complex molecules. Discover how different elements bond together, creating the substances that make up our world. Investigate the intricate dance of chemical reactions, learning how they power everything from the air we breathe to the food we eat. With Chemistry, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the fundamental principles that govern the physical and chemical properties of the world around us.
focus_areas: atomic structure, chemical bonding, chemical reactions, molecular properties

name: Physics
new_description: "description": "Physics is the study of the fundamental laws that govern the universe, from the smallest subatomic particles to the largest celestial bodies. Explore the mysteries of motion, energy, and the interactions between matter and forces. Dive into the captivating world of electromagnetism, where invisible fields shape the behavior of charged particles. Unravel the intricacies of thermodynamics, learning how heat, temperature, and energy transformations underpin the workings of our world. Venture into the bizarre realm of quantum mechanics, where particles exhibit mind-bending behaviors that challenge our intuitions about the nature of reality.",

name: Astrophysics
new_description: "description": "Astrophysics is the study of the physical laws and processes that govern the universe beyond Earth. Explore the nature of stars, galaxies, and cosmic phenomena like black holes, supernovae, and the Big Bang. Investigate the fundamental forces, energy sources, and particle interactions that shape the cosmos at the largest scales.",

name: Game Physics
path: Technical Skills > Game Development > Game Physics
new_description: "description": "Explore the captivating world of game physics, where the laws of nature come to life in virtual environments. Delve into the intricate interplay of forces, motion, and energy that govern the behavior of objects within games. From the graceful arc of a thrown projectile to the explosive impact of colliding bodies, you'll uncover the underlying physical principles that make game worlds feel authentic and immersive.
